limitations: Different runs remain separate states. Their observed note IDs may be compared for coverage, never merged as one inventory.
The in-run nine-note bar can hide auxiliary off-tower notes. Light run details and settlement explicitly show water7.
Unshown note categories remain null; no implicit zero filling or backfilling from other runs.
Most intervals contain multiple ordinary choices and rewards; these are not isolated battle samples.
No client version, confirmed phases or raw server response captured. Full joint training remains paused.
Videos and incidental desktop notifications remain local; only numeric annotations are public.
